description: This file implements a plugin module for the lightweight web server 'lighttpd'. It manages access control via URL allow/deny lists, providing functions for initialization, configuration merging, request handling, and response control based on access rules.

methods.name: mod_access_init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin data structure for the mod_access plugin.

methods.name: void mod_access_merge_config_cpv(plugin_config * const pconf,const config_plugin_value_t * const cpv)
methods.description: Merges individual configuration values into the plugin's configuration struct.

methods.name: void mod_access_merge_config(plugin_config * const pconf,const config_plugin_value_t * cpv)
methods.description: Iterates over configuration plugin values to merge them into the plugin's config.

methods.name: void mod_access_patch_config(request_st * const r,const plugin_data * const p,plugin_config * const pconf)
methods.description: Creates a per-request copy of the plugin configuration, applying relevant configuration rules.

methods.name: mod_access_set_defaults
methods.description: Sets default configuration values for the plugin during initialization.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ handler_t mod_access_reject(request_st * const r,const plugin_config * const pconf)
methods.description: Handles denying access to a request, possibly logging the action and returning a 403 Forbidden error.

methods.name: __attribute_pure__ int mod_access_check(const array * const allow,const array * const deny,const buffer * const urlpath,const int lc)
methods.description: Checks if a URL path matches the allow or deny lists to determine access permission.

methods.name: mod_access_uri_handler
methods.description: Main request handler that applies access control to incoming requests based on configuration.

methods.name: int mod_access_plugin_init(plugin * p)
methods.description: Registers the plugin with the server, setting version, name, and function pointers.
